results.title: NC State, UNC men's basketball to play non-conference game in Greensboro
results.description: CHAPEL HILL, N.C. (WNCN) — Turns out rivals UNC and NC State will face each other twice in men's basketball this season, but it won't be a traditional home-and-home set. North Carolina's athletic department announced Wednesday that the two teams will play in a non-conference game at First Horizon Coliseum in Greensboro on Dec. 15. [...]
